name: AskNicely
oneLiner: Customer experience platform for multi-location service businesses: NPS/CSAT surveys sent after each visit, feedback routed to the frontline staff who served the customer, reputation management, and NiceAI analysis and agents.
bestFor: Multi-location service brands (including hospitality) that want guest feedback to reach and coach individual frontline staff, not only head office. Not restaurant-specific; restaurant-focused tools such as Ovation are closer fits for many operators.

updates.text: Launched Ask NiceAI, a conversational AI interface inside the platform for asking questions of customer feedback data.
Launched Reputation Manager, which brings private survey responses, public online reviews and listing data into one system, with review requests and monitoring across review sites.
Added two AI agents: an Insights Agent that detects issues and trends and sends scheduled summaries to Slack or email, and a Response Agent that drafts replies to online reviews.

features: NPS, CSAT and other short surveys sent by email or SMS right after a visit or service
Feedback and mentions delivered to the individual staff member through a mobile app
Staff scorecards, leaderboards and coaching tools for frontline teams
Ask NiceAI: ask questions of feedback in plain language; theme and sentiment analysis of comments
Reputation Manager: review requests, review monitoring and listings alongside private survey data
AI agents that surface trends and draft responses to public reviews
Integrations with CRM, help desk and messaging tools (for example Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack)

pricing.text: Plans (Learn, Grow, Transform) priced by response volume and billed annually; NiceAI is an optional add-on. Search snippets of AskNicely's pricing page show Learn from $449/month billed annually, but third-party sources describe pricing as contact-sales, and the page could not be opened to confirm. Safest wording: pricing on request / starting price listed on asknicely.com/prices.
